text:
Jen: Heads up — I'm about to lift the runtime pin for eu-staging clusters (v2.14 -> v2.15). Doing a phased unpin over the next hour. @deploy-bot please hold if any SDK mismatch flags show up.
Owen: :eyes: what mismatch are you worried about? SDK 3.2 had that header change right?
Jen: Yeah, SDK 3.2.1 changed the model binding header (`X-Model-Bind`) which caused a small fallback in the hosted path last month. Want to make sure we don't reintroduce that for customers testing in staging.
Maria: Quick note — telemetry shows a tiny uptick in kv-cache misses for longseq on v2.15 in perf lab runs. Not blocking but worth watching.
Tony: Can we gate by runtime+sdk compatibility map? If deploy-bot can check deployed SDK versions on target nodes before unpin, we can auto-abort.
deploy-bot: run-check: compatibility-check --region eu-staging --runtime v2.15 --require-sdk <=3.2.1
Jen: Perfect. If check fails, abort and DM the release owners. If it passes for 10% of nodes, continue to 50% then full.
Kira: Suggest adding a smoke test step for the prefix-cache scenario: `POST /v1/generate` with a 1024-token prefix, ensure tail latency < 350ms. If it trips, roll back.
Owen: I'll add the smoke test to the canary job now. Pushing a tiny job: `ci/canary-eu-staging-smoke: add-kv-longseq` (PR up in 5).
deploy-bot: compatibility-check result: 8/12 nodes report SDK 3.2.2 present. 4/12 nodes at 3.2.1. Action: ABORT unpin.
Jen: Ugh. Thanks deploy-bot. That explains the potential risk. We'll hold and patch the SDK or pin the runtime for those nodes.
Tony: Recommend a short maintenance window tonight 22:00-23:00 UTC to roll SDKs on the 4 nodes then re-run the unpin. Keep stakeholders notified.
Maria: Filing a tiny release-note blurb so support knows why staging is still pinned.
Kira: If we can't upgrade SDKs quickly, we can do a targeted runtime pin exception for those 4 nodes and proceed elsewhere. But that complicates routing.
Jen: Let's avoid asymmetric routing for staging. Plan A: upgrade SDKs tonight and re-run. Plan B: if upgrade fails, we'll delay full unpin and run an extended canary for 24h.
Owen: PR merged for smoke test. CI will run once deploy-bot allows the canary.
deploy-bot: abort-notice sent to #eng-releases and DMs to @Jen @Owen. To retry: `deploy-bot retry-unpin --thread 1761004321` after compatibility-check green.
Jen: Thanks. I'll coordinate with infra to schedule the SDK upgrade. Leaving this thread open for rollout updates. :thumbsup:
